name: pwdev-feat
description: Fast feature plans and execution: PWDEVIA 7-question action plans with traceable acceptance criteria, an executor with IMPLEMENT/REPORT modes and resume, an advisor for hard decisions, evidence-based codebase mapping, reviews with stable findings, and E2E scenarios exportable to Playwright.

interface.longDescription: Map the codebase with evidence, plan a feature with the PWDEVIA 7-question method and traceable acceptance criteria, execute it with a fresh executor that verifies, commits and can resume, review a commit range with stable findings, and generate E2E scenarios that export to Playwright Test.
defaultPrompt: Map this codebase and write the planning context documents.
Plan this feature with the PWDEVIA method, then execute the plan.
Review the commits since main with stable, rule-cited findings.
